import sys, os, hashlib, time
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
SRC = dict(r28=live, r29=open(_p.__file__).read())
assert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r29'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('a8ad8dcc')
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('st_' + n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = {n: mk(n) for n in SRC}
STRAY = ['Attention: Chris Jones', 'Prepared by: Chris Jones', 'Chris Jones', 'cc: Lee Harbor', 'Reviewed: Lee Harbor, General Counsel',
         'Pat Smith', 'Initials: ____', 'Page 2 of 2', 'Witness: Chris Jones']
WHERE = dict(top_right=(150, 380), mid_right=(330, 360), footer_right=(740, 380), footer_left=(740, 72), margin_left=(330, 10))
G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))):
    for stray, where, layout, patname, fleetname, recital, signer in product(STRAY, WHERE, ('stacked', 'side'), ('none', 'blank', 'named'),
                                                                     ('dan', 'none'), ('parsed', 'none'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both')):
        if layout == 'side' and where == 'mid_right': continue
        fx, fy, hx, hy = (72, 260, 72, 470) if layout == 'stacked' else (40, 300, 320, 300)
        def blk(head, co, x, y, nm):
            rows = [(y - 50, head, False, x), (y - 38, co, False, x), (y, 'By:', True, x, x + 180)]
            if nm is not None: rows.append((y + 12, nm, False, x))
            return rows + [(y + 24, 'Title:', True, x, x + 180), (y + 48, 'Date:', True, x, x + 180)]
        rows = (blk('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', fx, fy, dict(dan='Name: Dan Whaley', none=None)[fleetname])
                + blk('RECIPIENT:', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', hx, hy, dict(none=None, blank='Name:', named='Name: Pat Smith')[patname]))
        y, x = WHERE[where]; rows.append((y, stray, False, x))
        pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
        if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
        people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
        allowed = {rc.PE: (2, hx, hy, hx + 180), rc.DE: (2, fx, fy, fx + 180)}
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS[recital]), rows]); k = ''
        for n, m in M.items():
            r = in_process(m, pdf, people, Mock())
            k += 'W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
        G[(layout, k)] += 1
        if k[0] != k[1] or 'W' in k: EX[(k, layout, stray, where, patname, fleetname, signer)] += 1
print('elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
for key in [lambda k: (k[0], k[2]), lambda k: (k[0], k[3]), lambda k: (k[0], k[4], k[5]), lambda k: (k[0], k[6]), lambda k: (k[0], k[1])]:
    print(sorted(Counter(key(k) for k in EX.elements()).items(), key=str))
